---
title: "Flags of the World"
format:
  html:
    echo: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(countrycode)

# Match available flag image filenames to country names
available_codes <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.png$") |>
  tools::file_path_sans_ext()

extra_countries <- tibble(
  country = c("England", "Northern Ireland", "Scotland", "Wales", "Kosovo"),
  code = c("gb-eng", "gb-nir", "gb-sct", "gb-wls", "xk")
)

flags <- codelist |>
  filter(!is.na(iso2c), tolower(iso2c) %in% available_codes) |>
  transmute(
    country = country.name.en,
    code = tolower(iso2c)
  ) |>
  bind_rows(extra_countries) |>
  arrange(country)

ojs_define(flags_data = flags)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Convert R data frame columns into an array of objects
flags = transpose(flags_data)

// Dropdown input to select a country
viewof selected = Inputs.select(
  flags,
  {
    label: "Select a country:",
    format: d => d.country,
    value: flags.find(d => d.country === "United States")
  }
)

// Display the selected country's flag
html`
  <div style="margin-top: 20px;">
    <h3>${selected.country}</h3>
    <img 
      src="data/${selected.code}.png" 
      alt="Flag of ${selected.country}" 
      style="max-width: 450px; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ddd; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"
    />
  </div>
`
```
